overall_reason: Everything is drawn from the subject: his blob-pattern helmet motif as the hero topography, LN mark, acid-lime from the helmet livery, a real 'Helmets Hall of Fame' archive (Basketball 2022, Silverstone 2020, Las Vegas 2023…), a next-race badge and own merch photography; no section survives a rival driver's name.

findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER / T-RIVAL-NAME: 'REDEFINING LIMITS, FIGHTING FOR WINS, BRINGING IT ALL IN ALL WAYS. DEFINING A LEGACY IN FORMULA 1 ON AND OFF THE TRACK.' stays true for any F1 driver; 'Redefining' and 'legacy' are stock sports-brand diction and 'bringing it all in all ways' says nothing.
findings.before: "Redefining limits, fighting for wins, bringing it all in all ways…"
findings.after: A line in his own voice or a fact only he has [DATA NEEDED: quote or season result to lead with]
findings.why: The one heading-sized line on the page that any driver site could carry; the typography around it is specific, the words are not.

findings.evidence: T-FIVE-SECOND, partly not verified: the captured first screen shows only the topographic blob background, the logo, STORE and menu, and a tiny 8px 'NEXT RACE / LAS VEGAS GP' card. The hero subject (likely a WebGL helmet or video) did not paint in the capture, so who/what/what-to-do rests on the logo alone.
findings.before: First screen = logo + texture + store button
findings.after: Make sure the first screen carries a static fallback image of the driver or helmet when the canvas has not loaded
findings.why: If the 3D layer fails or loads late (lab LCP 6.8s), the first screen says almost nothing.

strengths: The helmet archive is real, dated and only-this-driver: 'Basketball 2022', 'Silverstone 2020', 'Beachball 2023', 'Dark Mode 2024', each a cut-out on a notched card that echoes his badge shape.
Brand system taken from the subject: blob pattern from his helmet and jacket used as hero topography; lime #d2ff00 from the livery; serif/grotesk mix in the headings ('HELMETS / HALL OF FAME').
Own photography of the driver and merch (Champion hoodie, LN1 gold) rather than stock.
Next-race badge ('LAS VEGAS GP') is live, useful content.
not_investigated: The hero and several scroll-pinned sections (tiles 01, 03-07) painted as flat colour: WebGL/scroll-driven content did not render in the full-page capture. Not judged as design.
Store section heading in tile 11 is near-invisible dark-on-dark; likely captured mid-reveal animation (sweep contrast 1.00:1 hits on 'results' are probably the same cause).
